dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that legend real?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Why, experience would be a better teacher than I, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Take this starconch with you. Place this to your ear when you're alone...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Perhaps you'll really hear something. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: I sense that you are searching for someone... Am I correct?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Or perhaps you come here because of the legend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am searching for someone...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Then it is as I thought! Though for Miss Bu the Fortune Teller, this was easy to discern.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: People like you I can read like a book... Ahem, I mean, it is easy to tell the fortunes of those such as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: For example... I know that you hold many secrets in your mind... that you sometimes feel lonely... and that there is someone who holds a very special place in your heart...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could say that about anybody!

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Not so! These are specific truths I have clearly discerned about your individual fortune...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: ...I said too much in one go, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Lesson learnt. I'll know for next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What legend?

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Why, the legend of the conch lodge. It's very popular among the young people of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: ...You can hear the sound of the sea in a conch shell. The same is true of the conch lodge...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Only, the sounds heard here come not from the ocean blue... but from the Sea of Souls.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: If somebody hears sounds from the conch lodge, it could well mean that—

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Sorry! I didn't mean to scare you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Don't you want to hear what Miss Bu has for you? You're no fun.
